specs.Qualité: Proof La qualité "Belle Épreuve" est la plus haute qualité numismatique devant les qualités "Brillant Universel" (BU) et "courante". Une pièce belle épreuve est une pièce obtenue au moyen de coins et de flans spécialement préparés et de conditions de frappe particulières, de sorte que les motifs de gravure ressortent avec une grande netteté et que la surface est sans défaut. Les fonds de la gravure sont extrêmement brillants, les reliefs sont matés.

description_detailed: Disney's The Lion King is a true journey of initiation. It tells the story of Simba, a young lion cub destined to become king, who must overcome the tragic loss of his father, learn to forgive himself for his mistakes and accept his responsibilities to restore harmony to his kingdom.30 years after the theatrical release of one of Disney's greatest masterpieces, Monnaie de Paris pays a vibrant tribute to the characters of The Lion King with a nostalgic coin collection.This rectangular collector's coin features the final scene of The Lion King, where Simba and Nala present their son “Kion”, carried by Rafiki, to the land of lions. The reverse of this coin features a representation of Mufasa, rising majestically above the Lion’s Pride rock. The reverse also shows the face value of the coin and the initials of the French Republic.
